title: Successor step for formal smoothness of a Cohen ring modulo p powers
statement: Let p be prime and Λ a Cohen ring [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring]. Let n≥1 and suppose that Λ/(p^n) is formally smooth over ZMod (p^n) for every ZMod-algebra structure. Then Λ/(p^(n+1)) is formally smooth over ZMod (p^(n+1)) for every such algebra structure.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 0329 induction step, applying Tag 031L; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0329 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/031L

proof.text: A Cohen ring is torsion-free over ℤ: factor a nonzero integer as ±p^a b with p not dividing b. Bezout makes b a unit in the local ring with maximal ideal (p); p is nonzero since a DVR has nonzero maximal ideal. The domain property then makes each nonzero integer a nonzerodivisor. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pid-torsion-free-module-flat] and [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-quotient-flat] to obtain flatness of Z/p^(n+1)→Λ/(p^(n+1)).

In R=Z/p^(n+1) set I=(p^n). Since n≥1, 2n≥n+1, so I²=0. Reduction gives R/I=Z/p^n and S/IS=Λ/(p^n), since p^(n+1) is a multiple of p^n. Transport the hypothesis along these quotient isomorphisms and apply [lem-weil-pbc-lift-formal-smoothness-flat-square-zero]. All ZMod-algebra structures agree since every element of ZMod is an integer cast.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0329 successor step and Tag 031L; torsion-freeness and flatness verification written out by E2

theorem cohenRing_mod_pow_formallySmooth_step
    (p : ℕ) (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] (hΛ : IsCohenRing p Λ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (ih : ∀ [Algebra (ZMod (p ^ n)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ n})],
      Algebra.FormallySmooth (ZMod (p ^ n)) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ n})) :
    ∀ [Algebra (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ (n + 1)})],
      Algebra.FormallySmooth (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
        (Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : Λ) ^ (n + 1)})
